summary: Collective Mining Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed in the US under a 20-F/40-F shelf, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO interim certifications for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The filing is routine periodic reporting rather than a special situation: cash fell to $70.6 million from $129.6 million, exploration and evaluation expense rose to $41.1 million for the nine months, and the net loss widened to $55.9 million with a $10.6 million warrant revaluation charge.
